meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

howto.what: 你可以让Claude用10种预设主题（每种有配色和字体）来美化幻灯片、文档等作品，也可以让它根据你的描述即时生成新主题。
howto.when: 当你要求美化某个作品，或说“用某某主题”时；若现有主题都不合适，你可以要求创建一个新主题。

say.text: 给我的幻灯片应用“海洋深渊”主题。
say.note: Claude会应用该主题的配色和字体。

say.text: 为这份报告生成一个温暖色调的新主题。
say.note: Claude会创建新主题并展示给你确认。

howto.what_en: Claude can apply one of 10 preset themes (each with colors and fonts) to artifacts like slides, docs, or HTML pages, or generate a new theme on the fly based on your description.
howto.when_en: When you ask to style an artifact, request a specific theme, or describe a custom theme if none fit.

say_en.text: Apply the "Ocean Depths" theme to my slides.
say_en.note: Claude applies that theme's colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Create a warm-toned theme for this report.
say_en.note: Claude generates and shows a new theme for approval.
